bibl.title: Notes on Some Ostraca from the Maresha Excavations.
bibl.seg: Willy Clarysse, Notes on Some Ostraca from the Maresha Excavations.
bibl.note: Offers text-critical notes on several O. Maresha. They contain some interesting personal names and a date in year 12 according to the Ptolemaic system.
